name: trackcontrol
description: TrackControl - Control, seguimiento y conciliación de envíos con paqueterías externas

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @trackcontrol/api" "npm run dev -w @trackcontrol/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @trackcontrol/api && npm run build -w @trackcontrol/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @trackcontrol/api && npm run typecheck -w @trackcontrol/web
